{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute the raw difference in proportions (treatment - control) without any adjustment
# This is the estimand as stated: difference in proportions between arms
n_treatment = (df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment').sum()
n_control = (df_dedup['arm'] == 'control').sum()
responded_treatment = (df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment') & (df_dedup['responded'] == 1)
responded_control = (df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['responded'] == 1)
prop_treatment = responded_treatment.sum() / n_treatment
prop_control = responded_control.sum() / n_control
raw_diff = prop_treatment - prop_control

# Print the raw difference
print(f'Number of patients in final population: {len(df_dedup)}')
print(f'Number of treatment patients: {n_treatment}')
print(f'Number of control patients: {n_control}')
print(f'Proportion responded in treatment arm: {prop_treatment}')
print(f'Proportion responded in control arm: {prop_control}')
print(f'Raw difference in proportions (treatment - control): {raw_diff}')

# Return the raw difference
raw_diff"}
